meta.title: Act 2 — Sea: The Brine Reach
meta.note: The five main quests of Act 2 (game-story.md §4, issue #144). Today it holds only the act's ENTRY — the receiving half of the seam #143's closer states from its side — so that finishing the Bellwether puts the next step on the journal's shelf the moment Coil says 'the coast'. The rest of the act arrives with its zone (#152 through #156).
meta.loading: Loaded when `sea-revealed` is SET, not at boot and not on entering a zone — see ACT_PACKAGES in main.ts. The act's opening flag is its door for content exactly as it is for dialogue and shops (§6): a zone is the wrong key, because the quest that sends you to the coast must be readable while you are still standing in Embervale, and issue #150 already proved a package must survive its player crossing zones. Issue #209 records the decision.
meta.the-stub: `quest:sea/salt-and-rope` ships here without its giver, its location or its objective triggers, because `npc:gain/saltrest`, `town:saltrest` and zone `brine` do not exist yet and a reference to nothing is a diagnostic. #152 adds all three and wires them; the ORDERING is already final — `prerequisites` names the Bellwether, and that is the half the Act 1 epic's definition of done asserts.
